data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the start of 2015 were GBP 71.636m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net release on prior years (2013 and earlier) of approximately GBP 2.28m (c.3.2% of opening reserves), driven by favourable claims development primarily in the marine and energy classes. The managing agent also reports an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m for 2015 (2014: deficit GBP 1m) and attributes this to reserve releases on 2013 and prior years due to better-than-expected experience in marine and energy.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (-2.279m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 33 by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2013. The managing agent narrative reports a surplus of GBP 4.8m (likely a NET figure after reinsurance) which differs from the gross-triangle-derived PYD; the narrative appears to refer to net reserve releases. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was printed, so the triangle was used as primary source. All amounts presented in the statements are in GBP and shown in GBP '000 on the source pages.
